events.title: Development Update
events.summary: Hi everyone!Thank you all for your interest and wishlist support for Tidy Up Mall.Development of the game is nearing completion. To identify bugs and polish gameplay experience as mush as possible before the game launch, we plan to start a Playtest within the next 2-3 weeks. We will post more details about Playtest in the future, stay tuned!Thanks again for your support!
